name: No personal-account dealing policy
description: Staff allowed to trade personal accounts without disclosure / pre-approval / restricted-list checks.

name: No insider list maintained
description: No documented insider list; project-specific access not tracked.

name: No disclosure controls
description: No documented procedure for selective disclosure / cleansing announcements.

name: No MAR / market-abuse training
description: Staff and officers untrained on MAR red flags and reporting obligations.

name: No trade surveillance
description: No automated detection of spoofing / wash / layering across venues or pairs.

name: No STOR pathway
description: No documented escalation path to file STORs / suspicious-order reports with the NCA.
